name: jacob-gg-server-judge
description: Server-side judge fallback for jacob.gg: runs the exact production kev-0.6b q4 model through the exact browser onnxruntime-web WASM backend (not onnxruntime-node), for devices where the local in-browser WASM judge cannot run (e.g. iOS WebKit's shared-memory-growth ceiling). Deployed independently of the Cloudflare leaderboard worker. See README.md.
